Nasdaq 100 Companies

Explore the Nasdaq 100 index components, ranked by company weight from largest to smallest. While the index is heavily weighted toward technology companies, it also includes leading firms from sectors such as consumer services, healthcare, and industrials. The Nasdaq 100 is widely used as a key benchmark for the performance of the technology sector.
